entry.name: rnbo_ctlin
entry.description: Output the value from a specific MIDI controller number and channel.

arguments.name: controller
arguments.digest: controller number to receive (-1 for all)
arguments.description: In the second inlet, a number will describe the controller number that the ctlin object is to receive. This number can also be given as the first argument to ctlin. A value ofwill result in ctlin receiving all controller numbers.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.digest: MIDI Channel to receive (-1 for all)
arguments.description: In the third inlet, a number will describe the MIDI channel that the ctlin object is to receive. This number can also be given as the second argument to ctlin. A value ofwill result in ctlin receiving all channels.
